renderedFields.customfield_10700:
The following is applicable regardless of whether the Paper Out/Export is requested at the Transaction level or the Document level.

  1. Paper Out Request modal:
    1. Add a new Media Type for Paper Out Package section with two radio buttons:
      1. Print to Paper - Defaults selected
      2. Save as Electronic File
        1. When Save as Electronic File is selected and user clicks OK, open a new acknowledgement modal AFTER the required field edits are complete.
          1. Checkbox
            1. Blank by default
            2. When selected, enables the OK button
            3. When deselected, disables the OK button
          2. OK button
            1. When selected, closes the acknowledgement modal and then the Paper Out Request modal and proceeds with the creating the Work Queue item for the approval.
          3. Cancel button
            1. Always enabled.
            2. Closes the acknowledgement modal
    2. Clean up the formatting on the right side of the modal so section borders are aligned. The above mockup is still a little messy, but you get the idea.
  2. Additional Information (modal in UI) / Additional Event Information (table in downloaded activity history report):
    1. Currently, Media Type is logged in Additional Information for the Authorized Paper Out event. This should be moved to the Submitted Paper Out event since that is where the user is specifying how the Paper Out will be managed. As mentioned above, this is applicable for transaction and/or document (depending on where the Paper Out is initiated).
    2. We are NOT retroactively updating existing documents and/or transactions.
  3. eoRequestExport / export.xsd:
    1. Add a mediaType element with two valid enumerations:
      1. PrintToPaper
      2. SaveAsElectronicFile
    2. mediaType is optional since requiring it would break existing integrators
    3. Update the schema
  4. New Media Type logic (Note: Media Type is included as Additional Information in the Submitted Paper Out event in the audit trail (UI and downloaded) and displays on the cover page of the Paper Out/Export package.)
    1. Media Type = Paper if:
      1. UI user selects Print to Paper
      2. OR eoRequesExport passes PrintToPaper in the mediaType
    2. Media Type = Electronic if:
      1. UI user selects Save as Electronic File
      2. OR eoRequestExport passes SaveAsElectronicFile in mediaType
      3. OR eoRequestExport does not pass mediaType
  5. Verify Paper Out modal:
    1. Update the verbiage of the last checkbox:
      1. Current: Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed
      2. Update: Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed to paper or saved to a secure location
renderedFields.description:
Currently, the Paper Out/Export has logic for the Media Type that displays in the 1st section of the front/cover page and in the audit trail. If the Paper Out is performed via UI, it displays Paper. If the Export is performed via API, it displays Electronic.

This ticket enhances the Media Type logic and the Export process to capture and log whether the user intends to maintain the package digitally outside of the eAsset Management Platform or to convert to paper.

For reference, below are the current Paper Out Request and Additional Information modals.

NOTE: When updating the Paper Out Request modal, we should clean up and align the section borders on the right side of the modal.

When the media type is selected as Print to Paper.png
When the media type is selected as Save as Electronic File.png

comments.body: Pam Baumgarten in the proposed CC dialog….for the electronic radio button, rather than ‘stored as electronic copy’ how about ‘saved as electronic file’. I also think we need to put some warning indicating this process concatenates all included transactions and documents into a single tampersealed file that will not be able to be split apart without impairing the integrity of the tamperseal….or something like that.
Pam Baumgarten in 2b, rather than referring to as download, would ‘media type’ be more descriptive?
Pam Baumgarten 5.a.i….our audit trail already has an indication of where requests are initiated from. I think media type is more important.

Valerie Daly How about this?

WARNING:  The Paper Out® process produces a single file that is digitally signed with a certificate. Any modification, extraction, or separation of its contents will invalidate the digital signature and compromise the file’s integrity.

Once you click Verify, all source documents will be removed from the vault, and you will not have an option to download or print them again.

Pam Baumgarten on the request modal, let’s default to paper and add a warning if the user selects electronic that all exported documents are delivered concatenated in a single PDF and will not be able to be separated without breaking the tamperseal…..or we deliver a zip file instead (I’m not sure I love the zip file…don’t really want to make it easy to mass export).
